title: AMICULUM
description: AMICULUM is a unique conglomerate of 11 independent agencies delivering specialized communication and consultancy services to global pharmaceutical, biotech, and health technology organizations. Established in 2001, it has grown consistently due to its high-quality and compelling content, technical accuracy, and significant repeat business. The firm's agile and collaborative approach allows it to assemble the right team of over 350 healthcare communication professionals, ensuring exceptional service delivery. AMICULUM's global presence spans across Europe, Asia-Pacific, MENA, and the USA, with offices in Richmond, Chicago, Singapore, Bollington, Princeton, England, Basel, and Dubai. The company offers a wide range of services, including biostatistical design, clinical trial design, market research, medical writing, and digital communication, among others. Notably, AMICULUM holds the SBTI certification, indicating its commitment to setting near and long-term targets.

title: CNC
description: CNC operates out of multiple locations in New Delhi, India, providing specialized services within the realm of clinical research. It excels in Biobanking, Clinical Trial Consulting, Histology, Human DNA & RNA extraction, Immunohistochemistry, and many more areas. CNC is also known for its proficiency in Clinical Trial Feasibility and Integration Analysis. Certified by Good Clinical Practice (GCP), CNC maintains a vast and diverse collection of specimens, primarily Formalin-Fixed Paraffin-Embedded (FFPE) blocks, rich in various valuable features. Each FFPE block in their biobank is meticulously cataloged and accompanied by comprehensive pathology reports. They also provide FFPE blocks for mutation analysis, bolstering genetic research with their advanced Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) Data Analysis. CNC offers specimens tested through Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) and Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization (FISH) assays for targeted genetic research. Their unique offering includes Tissue specimens for longitudinal studies. CNC's commitment is towards advancing medical and scientific knowledge by providing high-quality specimens and associated data, thus facilitating progress in pathology and beyond.

title: Biosynth International, Inc.
description:
Biosynth International, Inc. is a globally recognized life sciences company specializing in reagents, custom synthesis, and manufacturing services. The company's unique focus is on securing the fragment pharma and diagnostic supply chain. Its comprehensive research product portfolio and manufacturing services are science-led and designed to solve problems while delivering key reagents at scale and with quality. Biosynth's expertise spans across fine chemicals, small molecules, peptides, and key biologics, all provided by one trusted partner. 

The company boasts a vast range of chemical and biochemical products and takes pride in its ability to deliver products that others cannot. With over a million products in its research catalog and hundreds of complex manufacturing service projects, Biosynth supports life science research and development comprehensively. 

Biosynth's small molecule chemistry specialties include enzyme substrates, carbohydrate and nucleoside chemistry, as well as intermediates, APIs, and controlled substances. The company's peptide division, with over 40 years of expertise, specializes in custom peptide synthesis from nanomole up to multi-kilogram scale. 

Furthermore, Biosynth offers a unique range of critical biological raw materials, including mono- and polyclonal antibody production, epitope mapping service, enzyme products, and custom enzyme development and production. These offerings have positioned Biosynth at the forefront of biocatalysis and antibody development. 

The company has multiple sites worldwide, including in Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, the United States, Austria, Slovakia, and Germany, reflecting its global reach. Biosynth International, Inc. is a certified Small Business (SB) in the US. For more information, visit https://www.biosynth.com/.

title: Delta4 GmbH
description:
Delta4 GmbH, located in Vienna, Austria, is an innovative biotech company specializing in AI Drug Discovery. Their unique approach centers on identifying previously unnoticed connections between well-established drugs and diseases to discover new therapeutic applications. Their specialized Hyper-C platform, managed by a team of expert computational biologists, houses an expansive collection of algorithmic intelligence.

Delta4's sophisticated process involves the use of big data to build molecular models that are matched to diseases through a cycle of iterative refinement. Utilizing thousands of pre-calculated models, the platform effectively aligns compounds with diseases, expediting biological testing and clinical trials. 

Delta4's services encompass a wide range of areas, including bioinformatics, biostatistical design, clinical data science, and cloud computing, among others. They have already demonstrated their high level of expertise and capability, earning high satisfaction ratings from several big names in the pharmaceutical industry. Delta4 GmbH stands as a leader in the field, providing valuable support in drug discovery and disease analysis.

title: Horizon Discovery Biosciences Limited
description:
Horizon Discovery Biosciences Limited, with locations in Cambridge, UK; Vienna, Austria, and Cambridge, MA, USA, brings decades of experience in cell line engineering, RNA synthesis, and bioinformatic design, offering a unique portfolio of tools and services to researchers. The company focuses on three key areas of the therapeutic ecosystem: basic research, drug discovery and development, and therapeutic applications. Their services include Screening & Cell line engineering, BioProduction cell lines, and contract research. 

With an impressive customer base that spans over 60 countries, Horizon caters to biopharmaceutical and diagnostics companies, contract research and manufacturing organizations, and academic researchers. The company's service group supports researchers with cell line engineering, functional genomic screening, high-throughput immuno-oncology assays, compound profiling, drug combination screening, using CRISPR, or siRNA for a variety of cell-based assays.

Horizon is a part of Revvity, a provider of health science solutions, technologies, and services that deliver complete workflows from discovery to development, as well as diagnosis to cure. Revvity is revolutionizing healthcare with specialized focus areas in translational multi-omics technologies, biomarker identification, imaging, prediction, screening, detection, diagnosis, informatics, and more. The company holds ISO 13485, ISO 9001, and ISO 9001:2015 certifications.

title: JOANNEUM RESEARCH Forschungsgesellschaft mbH
description:
JOANNEUM RESEARCH Forschungsgesellschaft mbH, located in Graz, Austria, is a publicly-owned research organization that specializes in the medical and health-related fields. Its primary clientele includes pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device companies. The organization is renowned for its commitment to industry standards, as evidenced by its certifications in Good Laboratory Practice and EN ISO 13485. 

JOANNEUM RESEARCH offers a broad range of services, including bioequivalence studies, biomarker discovery and validation, clinical research, and pharmacokinetic screening, among others. It is particularly skilled in conducting preclinical and clinical studies to investigate pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics of active pharmaceutical ingredients. 

The organization also provides bioanalysis and pharmaceutical analysis services under GLP and non-GLP conditions. It is adept at creating customized solutions in areas like cleaning validation, content determination, and impurity testing. Additionally, it offers data management and biostatistical services for clinical studies and develops clinical decision support systems for safe and evidence-based medical decision-making. 

Its multiple sites in Graz, Austria, are equipped with state-of-the-art facilities to support its comprehensive service offerings.

title: Myllia Biotechnology
description: Myllia Biotechnology, situated at Am Kanal 27 Vienna, Austria, is at the forefront of adopting robust technological advancements for drug target identification and validation. They leverage the power of CROP-Seq, an innovative CRISPR Droplet Sequencing workflow, to map thousands of genetic perturbations on a global transcriptome. This approach enables a paradigm shift for next-generation CRISPR screens, influencing the discovery of novel drug targets, elucidation of unknown drug action mechanisms, and understanding of disease-related genetic variants. Myllia collaborates with global biotech and pharmaceutical companies, offering high-throughput CRISPR screens in cancer cells or primary human T cells. They offer customized services, from project design to wet-lab screening and analysis of NGS data. Their services include Assay Development, Biomarker Discovery, Cell Based Assays, Cloning/Subcloning, and many more, all tailored to the specific needs of their clients.

title: TAmiRNA
description:
TAmiRNA, a distinguished biotech company, was established in 2013 in Vienna, Austria. They specialize in the discovery and validation of microRNA biomarkers for use in drug development, early disease diagnosis, prognosis, and as supporting elements in treatment decisions. The company employs advanced techniques to examine microRNA transcript levels in any cell tissue or biological sample. 

TAmiRNA has an impressive record in developing novel miRNA biomarkers for toxicology studies and as predictors of ailments. They use these biomarkers to formulate companion diagnostics and monitor disease progression. As a Contract Research Organization (CRO), TAmiRNA offers an array of high-quality microRNA services, including transcriptomics, spatial omics, custom microRNA biomarker discovery and validation, and extracellular vesicle analysis. 

They are also creators of 'toxomiR', a microRNA-based screening assay for organ injury, and 'hepatomiR', an assay for liver biomarker quantification. The company is recognized for its quality standards and is certified by the International Organization for Standards 13485 (ISO 13485).

title: Bottomley Consulting Group
description:
Bottomley Consulting Group, located in Overjise, Belgium, is a leading expert in Quality of Life Research with over three decades of experience in clinical trials design, systematic reviews, and international guidance in patient-reported outcomes (PROs) analysis. The company offers a bespoke consultancy service tailored to meet clients' specific needs, with a particular focus on QOL and PROs. The group has offered strategic advice to key regulatory bodies like the FDA and EMA and has supported numerous companies in securing PRO approvals. Their experience with various health technology assessment bodies assures an in-depth understanding of specific requirements. 

The company stands out for its unmatched experience with diverse measures and an impressive track record in designing and implementing EORTC measures and clinical trials. The founder's familiarity with these measures uniquely qualifies them to assist in the design, interpretation, and publication of studies and clinical trials. 

The group also offers training and educational programs covering all aspects of QOL use in both clinical and real-world studies, emphasizing the value of equipping researchers with the necessary skills to effectively use QOL data. Their work operates internationally across various disease settings.

description:

Their mission is to accelerate scientific breakthroughs by delivering unrivaled quality and insights. They serve as a reliable partner for companies in the discovery and preclinical phases, ensuring success with assured results and a pledge to excellence. 

OhmX.bio offers multi-omics solutions in several fields including (epi)genomics, translatomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, and bioinformatics. title: Volition
description:
Volition is a premier epigenetics biomarker firm, recognized for its unique liquid biopsy immunoassay method for profiling cell-free circulating nucleosomes. It provides a service model known as Nu.Q® Discover, which offers non-invasive, quantitative insights, enhancing the value in preclinical and clinical drug development programs across various therapeutic areas like oncology and inflammatory diseases.
  
Nu.Q® Discover targets biomarkers associated with innate immune activation (NETosis) and epigenetic inhibitors. These assays effectively correlate with disease and tumor burden, making them ideal surrogate endpoint markers for treatment response, residual disease, and relapse monitoring. Volition's development pipeline includes assay development, a novel proteomics approach to epigenetic profiling of circulating nucleosomes using Mass Spectrometry, and Toxicity Monitoring assays. 

The company operates from multiple sites including Carlsbad, CA, Henderson, NV in the United States, and Isnes in Belgium, offering services such as Apoptosis Assays, Assay Development, Biomarker Clinical Utility, Cardiovascular Toxicology, and several others.

title: Across Barriers
description: Across Barriers GmbH, located in Science Park Saarbrücken, Germany, aims to foster innovation in the pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and chemical industries through advanced research and development services. The company leverages in-vitro models of cell and tissue systems to simulate the transport of substances and formulations across biological barriers. This approach enables the determination of permeability and absorption properties, effectively distinguishing substances unsuitable for further development. The process not only reduces time and financial costs associated with active substance development but also minimizes high-cost, ethically contentious animal testing. Besides, Across Barriers' in-vitro models aid in the classification of innovative formulations, such as inhalation aerosols or transdermal applications, while offering insights into in-vivo behavior of substances. The company has been licensed to work with narcotics agents since 2003 and operates laboratories for biological and radioactive operations. By employing the "in vitro bioequivalence" concept, Across Barriers assists generic companies to circumvent or limit clinical studies. The company's proficiency in classifying substances in line with FDA-regulated BCS guidelines offers the potential for exemption from in-vivo bioequivalence and bioavailability studies. Across Barriers is committed to providing its clients with a competitive edge through its validated models and forward-thinking technology.

title: BioMed X
description:
BioMed X is a renowned independent research institute nestled on the campus of the University of Heidelberg in Germany. The institute also operates from another location at 55 Church St New Haven, CT, 06510 United States. BioMed X is dedicated to the provision of specialized contract research services in the field of T Cell Receptor (TCR) profiling for immunology discovery.

BioMed X possesses an unmatched expertise in a complex component of the human adaptive immune system: the T Lymphocyte. They have engineered a proprietary technology platform, which enables them to functionally identify and map cognate epitopes of human TCRs with high speed and precision. This technology facilitates the profiling of patient-derived TCR repertoires against vast libraries of putative target epitopes. 

The institute's cutting-edge technology platform closely mirrors the physiological processes underpinning antigen processing, presentation, and ligand-induced T-cell activation. The platform consists of three major components: a T Cell Reporter Construct, an Antigen-Presenting Cell Construct, and a Phenotypic Screening Platform. 

BioMed X's platform finds extensive application in diverse areas such as biomedical research, drug discovery in oncology, autoimmunity, and infectious diseases. They offer customized research projects on a fee-for-service basis, giving customers full ownership of the results at pre-defined terms without any obligation for royalty or milestone payments. Their services include Antigen Specific T-cells, Epitope Mapping, High Throughput Screening, T Cell Epitope Characterization, and TCR Repertoire Sequencing.

title: Domain Therapeutics
description: Domain Therapeutics, located in St. Laurent, Quebec, Canada, and Strasbourg, France, focuses on drug target assays, G-Protein Coupled Receptor (GPCR) assays, HTS assay development, high throughput screening, structure activity relationship (SAR), and target identification. The company employs BRET-based bioSensAllTM biosensor technology, providing detailed signaling profiling of GPCRs, RTKs, and their ligands. This technology allows for real-time monitoring of receptor proximal events linked to transmembrane receptor activity, such as G protein activation and β-arrestin coupling for GPCRs, and SH2-domain proteins for RTKs. Domain Therapeutics' assays offer a comprehensive fingerprint of any GPCR/RTK ligand and facilitate the study of receptor mutations' impact on their signaling. Its corporate strategy emphasizes technology validation through partnerships, generation of a pipeline of 1st in class drug candidates for high unmet needs in CNS and oncology, and valuation of preclinical tools through spin-out vehicles.

description:
Discovery Life Sciences is a leader in the field of biospecimen and biomarker specialization, boasting the world's largest biospecimen inventory and procurement network. title: Nuvisan
description:
Nuvisan, an integrated contract research organization, offers comprehensive services from molecular research to patient care. Established in 1979, it is one of Germany's first CROs, with facilities spread across Germany and France. Its clientele includes a balanced mix of pharmaceutical industries, biotech companies, and academic institutions. 

Nuvisan boasts a dedicated team of 870 employees, 40% of whom are academics, with 38% of these holding PhDs. The company prides itself on high staff loyalty, ensuring business continuity and the ability to build reliable, long-term relationships. 

Quality is a key metric for Nuvisan, with over 90% of their business coming from repeat customers. Their high standards have been recognized by numerous authority inspections, including BfArM, EMA, FDA, and ANVISA, with 71 sponsor audits & inspections in 2022 alone. 

Nuvisan's extensive service portfolio covers drug discovery R&D services, analytical labs, non-clinical studies, pharmaceutical services, clinical trials, and a range of complementary and standalone services. These offerings include lead discovery, early development, medicinal and computational chemistry, in vitro biology, in vivo pharmacology, DMPK & toxicology, biomarker discovery, QP services, clinical trial supply, formulation support, pharmaceutical testing, consultancy, data management, data sciences, medical writing, and PK analysis. 

Nuvisan holds several certifications, including Assessment and Accreditation of Laboratory Animal Care (AAALAC), Biosafety Level 2 (BSL 2), Brazilian Health Regulatory Agency (ANVISA), EcoVadis - Gold Scorecard, Enhancing Quality in Preclinical Data (EQIPD) - Self Certified, Good Laboratory Practice (GLP), and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP).

title: ProteiQ Biosciences GmbH
description:
ProteiQ Biosciences GmbH, based in Potsdam, Germany, is a frontrunner in the field of LC-MS/MS proteomics, with a particular focus on biomarker research. The company boasts of a comprehensive suite of optimized LC-MS/MS methods and sample preparation protocols. It is one of only two commercial LC-MS proteomics providers worldwide that marries in-house bioinformatics and LC-MS/MS method development.

ProteiQ Biosciences offers three main services. The first, PQ Discover, uses a next-generation proteomics approach for high-throughput global proteome profiling, enabling precise and multiplexed analysis of thousands of proteins in any biological matrix. The second, PQ Confirm, is a custom approach for identifying elusive proteins, facilitating the confirmation of interventional biomarker research hypotheses on any protein modification using targeted quantitative proteomics, high-resolution LC-MS, and targeted immuno isolations. Lastly, the company offers on-demand LC-MS consulting and method optimization for clients with their own LC-MS equipment.

title: PRIMACYT Cell Culture Technology
description:
PRIMACYT Cell Culture Technology, a German biotechnology company, specializes in providing biological matrices, primary human and animal cells, as well as media and consumables for in vitro technologies. With a focus on human health, animal health, and environmental toxicology, they supply skin cells and explants from humans and cynomolgus monkeys. They also offer liver cells, microsomes, and S9 fractions from a variety of sources including humans, cynomolgus monkeys, dogs, Göttingen minipigs, rats, mice, domestic farm animals, ducks, chickens, and rainbow trout. 

Operating under GLP certification, PRIMACYT provides contract research for diverse industries such as pharmaceutical, biotech, chemical, and cosmetics. The company has developed a technology platform for assaying uptake and efflux transporter activities in stably transfected HEK293-cell lines and primary hepatocytes. title: PAASP GmbH
description:
Established in 2015, PAASP GmbH is a pioneering full-service consulting and auditing firm that focuses on evaluating operational risks associated with the quality of research data. The company primarily serves organizations involved in innovative research, creating value through the discovery and validation of novel therapies. PAASP's value proposition lies in mitigating risks through research quality, boosting confidence in data, facilitating decision-making in service provider selection, and reducing costs by avoiding substandard services. 

PAASP’s unique analytics platform, PAASPort®, identifies potential bias and deviations from Good Research Practice at various stages - study design, conduct, data analysis, reporting, and storage. It includes over 200 key quality indicators for preclinical studies. The evaluation process identifies apparent risk factors and protective measures, influencing the integrity and robustness of research data. This research quality-based evaluation is crucial for identifying and engaging in research collaborations likely to deliver reliable data. PAASPort® is the only tool currently available for systematic and comparative analysis of preclinical research quality, supporting rational decision-making in early-phase innovative biomedical research funding.

Its comprehensive range of services extends from research to product commercialization, offering advanced protein and gene analytic capabilities for biologic therapeutics as well as cell and gene therapy platforms. 

The company's expertise in protein-based therapeutics is derived from the fusion of Protagen Protein Services in Europe and BioAnalytix in the US. In 2021, the addition of GeneWerk's capabilities in vector safety, integration site analysis, and bioinformatics further bolstered ProtaGene's portfolio. 

ProtaGene's unique combination of protein and gene-based analytical platforms position it as a leading analytic service provider across the biopharmaceutical and cell and gene therapy development sectors. The organization operates from four locations in Europe and North America, serving prominent biopharmaceutical and gene therapy companies worldwide. 

With over 25 years of market experience and a vast spectrum of validated analytical methods, ProtaGene assures the highest quality of service for customers in the pharmaceutical, biotech, and life science industry. It is a Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) certified entity.

title: Qiagen
description:
Qiagen is a premier global provider of Sample to Insight solutions, specializing in chemistries, technologies, and workflows renowned for their superior quality. With nearly four decades of proficiency in nucleic acid extraction, Qiagen exhibits an extensive portfolio encompassing DNA and RNA isolation, qPCR, digital PCR, dPCR assay design, Next-Generation Sequencing, and sophisticated bioinformatics data analysis pipelines. Furthermore, the company is a frontrunner in miRNA biomarker pre-clinical discovery, boasting over 15 years of experience in miRNA profiling.

Qiagen Genomic Services, a trusted partner, is committed to supporting clients from pre-clinical discovery through to diagnostics development and global commercialization, ensuring project timelines are adhered to. The company has performed over a million nucleic isolations through its Genomic Services and has over 20 years of excellence in sample prep, PCR, NGS, gene expression analysis, and miRNA profiling reagent development. With complete project oversight by a dedicated project manager and expert pre-and post-project consultations, Qiagen is equipped to guide your research and development every step of the way.

Qiagen operates in multiple locations including Germany, the United States, and the United Kingdom and holds certifications such as ISO 13485, ISO 9001, ISO 9001:2015, and SBTI - Net Zero Committed.

title: Sysmex Inostics
description:
Sysmex Inostics, a global leader in the field of liquid biopsy clinical testing, is a subsidiary of Sysmex Corporation. The company is committed to enhancing the lives of cancer patients through its pioneering technologies like the gold-standard OncoBEAM (BEAMing) digital PCR and NGS-based SafeSEQ. These technologies offer unmatched sensitivity in detecting tumor molecular alterations in various sample types. Sysmex Inostics has a strong presence across the globe, with sites in Baltimore, MD, USA, Hamburg, Germany, and Kōbe-shi, Hyōgo-ken, Japan.

Their main areas of focus include BioPharma liquid biopsy testing & services, CDx/IVD development, and patient testing services in the US. They offer a wide range of capabilities including custom biomarker assay development, global regulatory registration/approval, cGMP manufacturing, and full-service clinical trial project management. They are also involved in the development and commercialization of Companion Diagnostic (CDx) kits. Sysmex Inostics is a trusted partner to leading pharmaceutical companies, helping them introduce effective personalized cancer therapies to markets worldwide. The company holds a Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) certification.

title: Systasy Bioscience GmbH
description: Systasy Bioscience GmbH, based in Munich, Bavaria, Germany, is a pioneering firm that tackles the complex challenge of drug discovery for genetically complex brain disorders. Recognizing the difficulty presented by insufficient understanding of underlying biological mechanisms, Systasy offers innovative solutions. The company provides high throughput screening (HTS) methods that illuminate intricate cellular communication in primary mouse neurons and human disease models during the early stages of drug discovery. Leveraging highly multiplexed phenogenomic pathway profiling technologies, Systasy delivers unrivaled insights into mode-of-action. The company's services extend to target selection, lead discovery, and safety profiling. Additionally, Systasy offers a suite of services including Biomarker Discovery, Diagnostic Biomarkers Discovery, ELISA, Human iPSC's, In Vitro Neural Models, RNA profiling, and more, making it a one-stop solution for comprehensive drug discovery.

title: Sciomics
description: Sciomics, based in Neckargemünd, Germany, is a leading company in the field of advanced protein profiling, playing a vital role in the progression of biomedical research. Sciomics is constantly growing its biomarker signature pipeline to cover a broad range of clinical indications, thereby promoting Precision Diagnostics. Sciomics provides support in project planning, technical expertise, customized solutions, and comprehensive study reports. Their platform is utilized for protein biomarker identification and verification, novel drug target discovery, mode-of-action analysis, pathway activity analysis, and disease model characterization, among other key applications.

The company is closely affiliated with the renowned Helmholtz Institute for Pharmaceutical Research in Saarland (HIPS). SciVii Labs is composed of a team of specialized veterinarians and scientists who bring a wealth of knowledge and experience in fields including pharmacology, toxicology, cell biology, analytics, and regulatory requirements. They primarily offer services for pharmaceutical and chemical companies, particularly in in vivo efficacy and toxicity studies. The company is certified for Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and prides itself on its commitment to 3Rs animal welfare, model standardization, and high-quality animal models. SciVii Labs assists clients throughout the entire process, offering expert advice and comprehensive services, from study planning, execution, and sampling, to analysis and report preparation.

description: SensID GmbH, located in Rostock, Germany, is a company dedicated to bringing precision to molecular diagnostics (MDx). The firm specializes in creating and marketing reference materials and quality controls for DNA and RNA based diagnostics. SensID's products, which are characterized and manufactured to the highest standards, serve as an ideal solution for research and development programs, assay, and instrument validation requirements. Their diverse and ever-expanding product portfolio includes certified standards, clinical pathology, human biological samples, and product testing among others. These products serve as external controls and support accreditation, conformity assessment, and should be included in diagnostic kits. SensID can supply products compliant with RUO, IVDR, and/or FDA for use with IVD kits and within CDx programs. However, it should be noted that SensID is not a biobank.

description: SiRNA Bioscience is a notable company based in various locations across Istanbul, Turkey. They offer an extensive array of services, such as Anatomic Pathology, Biobanking, Clinical Trial Design and a wide variety of Fresh Functional Human Tissue Assays. They also provide extensive pathology information, patient’s clinical history documentation, and study support for clinical and pharmacogenomic studies. title: NIMGenetics
description:
NIMGenetics is a leading company in advanced genomics, transcriptomics, bioinformatics, and cell line characterization services. Their expertise in NGS, single-cell, and arrayCGH technologies makes them a valuable partner for the biopharma industry, CROs, and academic researchers. With the acquisition of Gene Predictis SA in Switzerland, NIMGenetics has expanded its capabilities to include molecular microbiology analyses, polygenic risk scores development, and genotyping platform design. 

The company prides itself on its speed, competitive pricing, and tailored R&D services. Notably, NIMGenetics is the first human genetic diagnosis company globally to earn a B Corp certification, demonstrating its commitment to social and environmental impact. 

The company integrates state-of-the-art technologies with a proprietary pipeline for genomic analysis. This includes internally developed bioinformatics tools, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and a large proprietary genetic database. 

NIMGenetics also maintains clinical relationships with leading hospitals and clinics, and its repository of clinical genomics data makes it an excellent partner for supporting R&D projects from early discovery to clinical trials. 

Offering services like whole-genome and exome sequencing, gene expression profiling, DNA-encoded chemical libraries, genomics for cell and gene therapy, and more, NIMGenetics supports research in a variety of fields including oncology, rare diseases, regenerative medicine, and many others. 

The company operates from multiple sites worldwide, including Madrid, Spain; Lausanne, Switzerland; Lisbon, Portugal; and São Paulo, Brazil. It holds numerous certifications, including B Corp Certificate, ISO 14001, ISO 15189, and ISO 9001:2015.

title: Quibim
description:
Quibim, a transformative healthcare technology company, delivers innovative solutions to transform imaging data into actionable predictions. The company's cutting-edge tools are designed to unlock the potential of imaging data to improve patient outcomes. Quibim caters to a diverse clientele including healthcare providers, biopharma companies, research and academic institutions, and Real-World Evidence (RWE) specialists. 

Quibim's unique approach to problem-solving guides decision-making at every stage of drug development. The company unveils a comprehensive suite of novel imaging biomarkers from both existing and new patient datasets to bolster the power of multi-omics. This in-depth analysis of disease mechanisms assists in patient stratification, predicting patient outcomes and drug responses, and monitoring treatment progress with a tissue-agnostic approach.

As a global frontrunner in medical imaging analysis and processing, Quibim's top-tier software medical devices and solutions offer objective and highly accurate information compared to traditional methods. Using the latest AI technology, Quibim employs advanced image harmonization techniques that generate standardized image quality, minimizing variability across equipment manufacturers and acquisition protocols. The company has access to large-scale databases and can analyze any image modality and any tissue from thousands of consecutive patients. However, it is important to note that pathological images are not analyzed. 

Quibim operates from multiple locations including Valencia, New York, Madrid, Barcelona, and Cambridge. The company holds certifications from the European Economic Area (CE Mark Conformity) and the Medicines and Healthcare Products Regulatory Agency (MHRA). The extensive services offered by Quibim involve Biobanking, Bioimaging, Biomarker Discovery, Clinical Imaging Diagnostic Analysis, Market Access, and much more.

title: ZeClinics
description: ZeClinics, based in Barcelona, Spain, is a Contract Research Organisation renowned for their specialized use of the zebrafish model in pre-clinical testing. Their expertise in CRISPR genome editing facilitates the development of customized zebrafish genetic models that mirror human disease, allowing for the evaluation of the biomedical significance of potential compounds and genes in a live setting. This innovative approach bridges the gap between cell and rodent experimental models, accelerating the process of drug and target discovery while also reducing costs. ZeClinics offers tailored services to suit the needs of a diverse range of industries including Biotech, Pharma, Agrochemical, Food, and Cosmetics. Their offerings are grouped into three main platforms: ZeEfficacy, ZeTox, and ZeGenesis. These platforms encompass a wide array of services such as disease model development, general and organ-specific toxicity testing, and efficient mutagenesis, transgenesis, and gene expression modulation for the creation of human disease models in zebrafish.

title: CellMade
description:
CellMade, located in Ruffieux, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, France, is a biopharmaceutical company committed to developing early diagnostic and prognostic tests as well as novel treatments for Metabolic Disease and its related conditions. Notably, the company is addressing the global prevalence of Obesity and its hepatic manifestation, NAFLD-NASH, for which there are currently no approved drugs. 

CellMade has identified and validated a set of blood lipids capable of distinguishing between various stages of NAFLD-NASH, thereby predicting a patient's risk profile and response to treatment schedules. This breakthrough in biomarker signatures represents significant progress in tackling societal challenges associated with the Obesity pandemic and the development of associated comorbidities such as T2DM, CVD, and COPD.

CellMade also offers a broad range of laboratory services, including Biobanking, Cell-based assays, Cytometry and Mass Spectrometry assays and Bioinformatics, which are derived from its in-house research activities. These services are designed to assist in developing tools for Metabolic Disease, facilitating robust analysis of cell models for a diverse range of applications, from new drug compound safety and efficacy testing to biomarker discovery.

title: CYPRIO
description: CYPRIO is a French company based in Romainville, Ile de France, with expertise in developing and commercializing advanced 3D models. Their services include 3D cell culture, 3D InSight™ Liver Microtissues, and human organoid production among others. CYPRIO is known for their innovative HepatoPearls and HCLPearls, 3D organoids of primary human and rat hepatocytes and HepaRG cell lines respectively, encapsulated within alginate solution. This patented technology facilitates the self-assembly of cells into organoids within a week. They also offer a customizable encapsulation service for a variety of cell lines provided by their clients. Their organoids are easy to handle, adaptable to any bioassay or bioimaging, and can predict liver in vivo response with improved precision. This makes them a promising alternative to animal models. As a certified small business in the US, CYPRIO is dedicated to providing physiologically-relevant 3D models, contributing to the advancements in in vitro toxicology testing, hepatocyte toxicity analysis, and metabolic stability in hepatocytes. title: Calixar
description: Calixar, based in Lyon, France, is a pioneer in the field of protein and antigen isolation. The company has developed innovative techniques to isolate full-length membrane antigens and proteins such as GPCRs, Ion Channels, Transporters, Receptors, and Viral Proteins, with the highest purity levels. Their approach maintains the structural and functional integrity of these components, providing pharmaceutical companies with superior quality targets or antigens for vaccine development, antibody production, and primary lead discovery through Structure Based Drug Design or High Throughput Screening assays. Calixar's team utilizes MicroScale Thermophoresis (MST) combined with Isothermal Spectral Shift detection to perform ligand binding assays. This advanced technology enables accurate measurement of ligand binding parameters and comparison of multiple ligands. Their use of the Monolith X (Nanotemper) device further enhances their analytical capabilities for characterizing protein-ligand interactions across a wide range of membrane targets.

description:
CTIBiotech, based in Meyzieu, France, is a leading entity in the field of bioengineering and regenerative medicine. description: Founded in 2011 by Prof. Karl-Heinz Krause as a spin-off from the University of Geneva, NEURIX is a pioneer in the study of neurodegenerative diseases and related brain disorders. title: NETRI
description: NETRI is a pioneering industrial startup situated at 321 avenue Jean Jaurès LYON, AURA, 69007 France. They offer unique services to healthcare industries by generating mini human organs on a chip. This innovative approach, combined with AI treatments, can forecast the clinical impact of a drug candidate. NETRI supports its clients throughout the developmental stages of their products or drugs, providing predictive data on toxicity, efficacy, and modes of action during the discovery, preclinical, and clinical phases. The company's organ-on-a-chip devices facilitate the creation of healthy or pathological physiological models. Currently, NETRI is marketing its NeuroFludidics™ organ-on-a-chip models for use in pain management, cosmetics, and nutritional health applications.

title: Trans Chromosomics, Inc.
description:
Trans Chromosomics, Inc., based in 86 Nishi-cho Yonago, Tottori, Japan, is a cutting-edge biotech company specializing in chromosome engineering technology. Established in 2014, the company has transformed over four decades of basic chromosome research into practical applications for medical treatment and drug discovery. Beginning with the development of a human mono chromosome library and chromosome transfer technology, Trans Chromosomics has made significant strides in the field. Notably, their collaboration with Kirin Brewery Co., Ltd. (now Kyowa Hakko Kirin Co., Ltd.) led to the creation of the world's first fully human antibody-producing mouse, paving the way for a new era of antibody drugs.

Trans Chromosomics offers various services including ADCC and CDC Assay Services, Antibody Humanization, Antibody Sequencing, In Vivo Pharmacokinetics, Model Development, and Phage Display, among others. Their technological innovations include the development of humanized model mice and rats, discovery of fully human antibodies, and pharmacokinetic studies. 

Their key technology, the Artificial Chromosome Vector, allows for the introduction of giant genes and multiple genes. It functions as a high-performance remote controller that issues commands to cells. Practical applications include fully human antibody-producing animals, rare disease animal models, and cells/animals for functional evaluation. 

Trans Chromosomics is committed to applying innovative technology to battle intractable diseases, striving to reach patients suffering from these illnesses as quickly as possible. Their contribution to health and medical treatment through their advanced technology is truly groundbreaking.

title: GenScript
description:
GenScript is a globally recognized biotech firm that provides a diverse range of services including gene, peptide, protein, CRISPR, and antibody services to partners across the biotech, pharma, and academic sectors. Leveraging its unique and advanced gene synthesis technology, GenScript has emerged as the leading gene synthesis provider globally. The company specializes in delivering precise mutant library services that support the optimization of antibodies and proteins. It also offers services for monoclonal antibody development, accelerating the discovery of high-quality antibodies with diverse epitope specificities in a cost-effective way. 

GenScript's product offerings comprise a broad spectrum of catalog products, research instruments, therapeutic and diagnostic support materials, simplifying and expediting research processes for scientists worldwide. The company's continued innovation has facilitated impressive business expansion and the establishment of platforms such as a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO), a global cell therapy group, and an industrial synthetic products platform. 

These platforms collectively provide comprehensive solutions for biologics’ discovery and development, CAR-T cell therapy strategies, and the development of industrial enzymes. As of 2020, GenScript employs a workforce of more than 3,000 employees, approximately 30% of whom hold Master's and/or Ph.D. degrees. The company's facilities and subsidiaries are spread across the US, Europe, and Asia, and its growth over the past 18 years has been largely driven by partnerships with scientists engaged in basic life science research, translational biomedical research, and early-stage pharmaceutical development.

The company holds ISO 9001 and ISO 9001:2015 certifications and is recognized by the Office of Laboratory Animal Welfare (OLAW). GenScript operates from various locations worldwide, including Singapore, the United States, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and China.

title: Mimetas B.V.
description:
Mimetas B.V. is a pioneering company that develops human tissue and disease models for the creation of improved therapies. Operating from its sites in Oegstgeest, Zuid-Holland, Netherlands, and Gaitherburg, MD, United States, the company provides a range of services including 3D Cell Microscopy Assay, Angiogenesis Models, Apoptosis Assays, and more. 

Mimetas B.V.'s flagship product is OrganoPlates®, a groundbreaking tool in organ-on-a-chip biology. These microfluidic 3D culture plates can support up to 96 tissue models on a single plate and are based on the industry-standard 384-well plate for seamless compatibility with liquid handling and readout equipment. OrganoPlates® contain Phaseguides, a proprietary technology that allows membrane-free definition of tissues in microfluidic chambers. 

The plates facilitate the creation of complex tissue models through their support of chemical gradients and co-culture conditions. Within OrganoPlates®, cells are housed in a gel, which fosters 3D tissue configurations and cell-to-cell interactions, while a continuous perfusion of media through the plate mimics blood flux and exchange of nutrients, oxygen, and metabolites.

Concept COA is committed to providing cost-effective, insightful strategies, designed with early product development budgets in mind, from pre-clinical through to pivotal trial design input.

title: Cyprotex plc
description:
Cyprotex plc, a subsidiary of Evotec, operates from its premises located at Alderley Park in Macclesfield, UK, and Framingham, MA, USA. Its team of dedicated and proficient employees boast expertise in a plethora of specialized techniques gained across a variety of industries. While the company primarily serves clients in pharmaceutical research, it also caters to the chemical, cosmetics and personal care, agrichemical and tobacco industries. 

Cyprotex is a specialist in in vitro and in silico ADME-Tox services, offering in vitro ADME screening to support discovery projects, regulatory in vitro ADME, and DDI studies during preclinical and clinical development. It also provides specialized mechanistic in vitro human and animal toxicity models, including 3D models and MEA electrophysiology, and PBPK/QSAR modelling expertise. 

In addition to serving clients directly, Cyprotex places a strong emphasis on R&D and regularly shares its findings at scientific conferences and through publications. The acquisition of Aptuit in August 2017 by Evotec has further expanded the group’s capabilities, adding complementary drug discovery abilities, full CMC, and IND-enabling services, thus allowing the Evotec Group to provide expert support across the value chain, from early discovery through to preclinical development and beyond.

title: Carcinotech Ltd
description: Carcinotech Ltd, headquartered in Roslin Innovation Centre, Easter Bush campus Edinburgh, United Kingdom, is a leading MedTech firm renowned for its expertise in fabricating 3D-printed micro-tumors using patient-derived biopsies, primary cells, immune cells, and cancer stem cells. The company's innovative platform facilitates prompt, ethical, and precise drug screening, pre-clinical, and personalized medicine testing. Leveraging patient biopsies, tissue engineering, state-of-the-art robotic manufacturing, and stringent quality control, Carcinotech produces highly predictive, assay-ready printed tumors. These models offer clients a "clinical biopsy" quality model representing donor-specific cancer heterogeneity. In collaboration with global partners, top pharmaceutical companies, surgeons, pathologists, clinicians, and industry leaders, Carcinotech aims to expedite drug discovery and facilitate the introduction of effective cancer treatments. The company's robotic and automated manufacturing further enables speedy production, with models boasting high-throughput capabilities.

Their lab-benchtop PhysioMimix™ microphysiological systems allow researchers to simulate human biology in the lab, bridging the gap between traditional cell culture and human studies. description: The Drug Safety Research Unit (DSRU) is a UK-based organization that has been at the forefront of monitoring and studying the safety and risk management of medicines since its establishment in 1981. Located in Blundell Lane Bursledon, the DSRU is a leading pharmacoepidemiological unit that conducts observational studies in both primary and secondary care, many of which are Post-Authorisation Safety Studies (PASS) that form part of Risk Management Plans (RMPs) in Europe. With a dedicated focus on pharmacovigilance, the DSRU is primarily involved in detecting side-effects associated with the use of marketed drugs. The unit undertakes comprehensive research studies and evaluations on the safety of medicines and offers education and training in pharmacovigilance and related areas. An independent entity, the DSRU is recognized for its scientific excellence through its clinical research database studies that support public health decisions and the production of international peer-reviewed publications. It continues to make invaluable contributions in post-marketing surveillance of pharmaceutical products, earning global recognition and endorsement from regulatory authorities, healthcare professionals, and the pharmaceutical industry.

title: DefiniGEN Ltd
description: DefiniGEN Ltd, located at Babraham Research Campus in Cambridge, UK, is a revolutionary company reshaping the field of in vitro liver models. The company's innovative technology enables the large-scale production of hepatocyte-like cells (HLCs), known for their unmatched purity, enhanced functionality, and high hepatic relevance. Overcoming the constraints of primary human hepatocytes and liver cancer cell lines, DefiniGEN employs CRISPR-based gene editing to create HLCs from iPSCs that replicate liver disease phenotypes across a myriad of conditions. This provides a unique platform for studying both rare monogenic and complex liver diseases. Importantly, DefiniGEN introduces high-functioning, healthy HLCs for predictive toxicology studies and novel liver disease models to markets with unmet clinical needs, thereby reducing the risks associated with late-stage drug development. The company's mission is to guide drug development processes through uncharted territories, minimizing failure risks, reducing costs, and setting the stage for a more efficient future in drug discovery. DefiniGEN is certified by the International Organization for Standards 9001:2015 (ISO 9001:2015).

title: Erebagen
description:
Erebagen is a synthetic biology company based in Coventry, UK, at The Venture Centre on Sir William Lyons Road. The company specializes in the discovery, optimization, and scaling of unique bioactive products derived from microbes. Erebagen's innovative approach involves activating previously dormant biosynthetic gene clusters, utilizing data-driven automation and machine intelligence to unlock the potential of bacteria, nature's most prolific innovators. 

Erebagen's work primarily focuses on the development of microbial bioactives sourced from nature, with applications in human health, agriculture, and industrial biotech. Despite these bioactives constituting nearly half of all marketed medicines, less than 20% of their biosynthetic pathways are activated when bacteria are grown in laboratories. Erebagen aims to revolutionize this by targeting the majority of the silent microbial biosynthetic gene clusters, employing proprietary biosynthetic engineering tools to modify the discovered compounds. 

The company provides services such as bacterial cell culture, microbiology, natural product libraries, natural product screening, recombinant proteins, and target validation. Their technological prowess allows for the discovery of new compounds, development of natural products, and the discovery of novel biocatalysts, thereby addressing substantial unmet needs in their market.

title: ImmuONE
description: ImmuONE is a UK-based company located at Sycamore House, 16 Leyden Rd, Stevenage, Heartfordshire, SG1 2BP. The company specializes in a wide array of services including 3D Cell Culture, Antibody based Assay Development, Cellular Immunology Consulting, Cytotoxicity Testing, High Throughput Screening, and Inhalation Toxicology among others. Traditionally, alveolar safety has depended on epithelial cell models which primarily focus on barrier function or cytotoxicity. These models may overlook potential long-term adverse effects on lung health, particularly inflammation from chronic product administration. ImmuONE addresses this by employing immune-competent models that capture the nuanced responses of alveolar macrophages. The company offers unique in vitro models and multi-endpoint assessments that deliver results across morphology, function, and biochemistry. Their services enable a comprehensive understanding of how alveolar macrophages respond to inhaled substances and provide a cost-effective alternative that reduces animal testing. ImmuONE's in vitro services specialize in alveolar cell painting assays and their two novel products - ImmuPHAGE™ and ImmuLUNG™ - provide in-depth analysis of macrophage responses in the lungs and epithelial tissue of the alveoli.

title: Pear Bio
description:
Pear Bio, based at Imperial College White City IHub in London, United Kingdom, is a leading computational biology company. They have created a distinctive precision medicine platform which focuses on guiding treatment decisions for cancer patients. This revolutionary platform grows patient's tumors in a laboratory setting and conducts therapy dosing on parallel microtumors to evaluate response. 

The platform combines the use of organ-on-a-chip technology and computer vision to track cancer progression over time. Pear Bio cultures patient tumor samples ex vivo and tests various treatment options and combinations. A unique computer vision/machine learning pipeline identifies image-based spatial biomarkers in time-course 3D microscopy data from the patient's tumor cultures. 

Notably, Pear Bio's platform has significant applications in drug development, including combination therapy screening, and clinical biomarkers. The company also offers a range of lab services such as compound screening, 3D image analysis, combination therapy synergy testing, drug translation services using primary tumors, and clinical biomarkers and patient stratification.

Sygnature Discovery is a renowned independent provider specializing in integrated drug discovery and pre-clinical services. Established in 2004, the company is dedicated to expedite the transformation of potential new medicines from research labs to clinics, aiming to treat patients suffering from various debilitating and life-threatening diseases. Possessing a fully-equipped, research-focused organization, Sygnature Discovery boasts professional skills and expertise to undertake the most challenging drug discovery programs.

The company operates multiple sites across the United Kingdom and Canada and holds certifications including Biosafety Levels 1 and 2, EcoVadis - Bronze Scorecard, Human Tissue Authority, ISO 27001, and STUK (Radiation and Nuclear Safety Authority).

title: Venomtech Ltd
description:
Venomtech Ltd, based in Discovery Park, Sandwich, UK, is a prominent supplier of venom-derived compound libraries or arrays, extensively utilized for drug and biopesticide discovery screening. The company has engineered a comprehensive method for creating targeted arrays from venom, effectively addressing key challenges in drug and pesticide discovery, such as low hit rates and selectivity. 

Their custom-designed Targeted-Venom Discovery Arrays (T-VDAs) consist of hundreds to thousands of molecules, predominantly peptides, curated from relevant venomous species. The goal is to uncover novel compounds that selectively bind to specific targets. Their unique strengths lie in their profound understanding of which venoms are likely to have components hitting a given target, their expertise in separating individual venom components, and their ability to interpret complex data emerging from a venom screen. Their distinctive and diverse venomous animal library ensures high-quality arrays and data reproducibility. 

Services they offer include Antibody-Drug Conjugation, Antimicrobial Peptide Synthesis, Antivirals, Biomarker Discovery, Cardiovascular Toxicology, Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls (CMC), and more. Their offices are located at Building 500, East Block, Ground Floor Discovery Park Sandwich, CT13 9FE United Kingdom.

title: Cytosurge
description:
Cytosurge, a biotechnology company founded in 2009 in Glattbrugg, Switzerland, specializes in the development and manufacturing of advanced gene-engineered cell lines through its proprietary CellEDIT – CRISPR Cell Line Engineering Service. This service offers researchers unprecedented control over cellular experiments, promoting breakthroughs in various fields such as disease modeling and immunology. 

CellEDIT's gene editing capabilities include precise gene engineering, knock-in, knock-out, and multiplexing. Its unique intra-nuclear injection method ensures gentle and accurate editing, reducing transfection impact on cells and enabling complex modifications in challenging mammalian cell lines.

Some distinct features of CellEDIT include vector-free single-cell transfection, high precision and control in single-cell transfection, versatility and compatibility with mammalian cells, and dedicated expert support. The service is adaptable to specific research needs, facilitating a wide range of applications across scientific disciplines such as cell biology, neuroscience, regenerative medicine, and drug discovery.

With the vision to unlock new treatments by translating innovative genetic designs into living cells, Cytosurge's unique single-cell gene editing service contributes to advancements in cell and gene therapy treatments, paving the way for better human well-being.

description:
Ectica Technologies, a pioneering Swiss life science company, is at the forefront of pre-clinical drug discovery. Ectica Technologies also boasts a talented team of professionals who collaborate with clients on projects, particularly in oncology research and discovery. title: BioXpedia A/S
description:
BioXpedia A/S, established in 2016 in Aarhus, Denmark, is a contract research laboratory renowned for its high-quality, cost-effective bioanalytical services. Specializing in high-throughput sample preparation and multiomic screening and analyses, BioXpedia prides itself on rapid and efficient services using multiplex low-volume technologies. The firm offers a wide array of services, including absorption studies, cell culture, biomarker discovery, genotyping, and proteomics. 

BioXpedia is adept at handling various types of extractions like RNA, DNA, and protein from diverse samples such as tissue, blood, and cell-free specimens. The company applies automated pipetting and conducts quality control on all samples before analysis. 

In terms of DNA analysis, BioXpedia excels in SNP genotyping, rare mutation detection, and gene expression assessment. For protein biomarker screening, the company utilizes Olink Immuno-PCR Assays for high-throughput, multiplex immunoassay panels. Moreover, absolute protein quantification is achieved through Meso Scale Discovery (MSD) and ELISA. 

In 2023, BioXpedia broadened its service range by integrating pharmacokinetics and various animal models. The company now specializes in conducting pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic studies in rats and mice, providing invaluable insights into drug absorption, distribution, metabolism, and elimination. 

Furthermore, BioXpedia also offers biostatistical services to extract more data, covering basic normalization and identifying significant differences between groups. Custom-tailored packages are also available for advanced experimental setups or when detailed statistics are required.

title: Pharmaseed
description: Pharmaseed is a company boasting two decades of expertise in the application of unique in-vitro and in-vivo models, advanced research capabilities, and clinical services. It operates under Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) conditions and offers accelerated study tracks, with in-vivo study initiation achievable in less than two months. Over half of Pharmaseed's personnel are at the PhD level, and the company has a successful 20-year history of regulatory submissions. This has resulted in a client return rate of over 85%, with experience spanning startups, big pharma, medical devices, nutraceuticals, and the cannabis industry. The company specializes in a wide array of in-vitro and in-vivo models, including cardiovascular disease, oncology, immunology, inflammation, neurology, metabolic disorders, microbiome, infectious disease, and ophthalmology, among others. Furthermore, Pharmaseed displays expertise in advanced therapies such as gene and cell therapy, gene editing, stem cells, 3D cultures, and engineered cells. The company operates a BL2 safety unit and works with various animal models. Pharmaseed is also adept at clinical trial design and execution.

description:
eDNA Teknoloji Ltd., recognized as Genoma Biobank, is a top-tier biobanking solution located in the dynamic city of Izmir, Turkey. The company boasts a dedicated team of proficient physicians, scientists specializing in fields like oncology, molecular biology, and project managers committed to delivering superior services, including follow-up of custom protocols and on-site visits. 

Strategically placed in Izmir, Genoma Biobank serves as a hub to an expansive clinical network that stretches across Turkey's population of 85 million. Collaborating with over 15 advanced clinical partners, some with millions of annual patients, it ensures extensive coverage and access to a diverse array of biological samples, particularly in oncology, autoimmune diseases, and chronic neurological conditions. 

The biobank offers custom prospective collection and a bank of approximately one hundred thousand samples ready for immediate delivery. It ensures all processes are IRB reviewed for ethical considerations and verifies that all specimens are HIV/HBV/HCV negative and non-infectious. 

Genoma Biobank takes pride in its unparalleled laboratory processing services, which include sample storage, processing, retrieval, histology and tissue culture applications, molecular cytogenetics applications like FISH and in-situ PCR, and advanced molecular biology protocols including NGS. The company guarantees a seamless and professional biobanking experience that combines scientific expertise with efficient project management.

title: Bonds Biosystems Corporation
description:
Bonds Biosystems Corporation, based at 27 Strathmore Road, Natick, United States, is a pioneer in the development of in vitro 3D Human-derived Adipose Tissue and Heart Spheroids and Organoids. They specialize in producing self-assembled and Matrigel-free 3D human models, differentiating themselves from competitors. Furthermore, the company is developing innovative Adipose Tissue and Heart 3D human models derived from human-induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs). They are also set to launch hiPSC-derived Heart spheroids and Heart Organoids to test drugs cardiotoxicity and cardiovascular diseases.

Bonds Biosystems is committed to making the development of human physiologically relevant 3D organoids more accessible, with a mission of turning innovative science into more accurate and affordable therapies for patients worldwide.

title: Pharmaron (Exton) Lab Services (formerly Absorption Systems)
description: Pharmaron (Exton) Lab Services, previously known as Absorption Systems, is a leading service provider that emphasizes the use of the most relevant physiological models to enhance the accuracy of research from discovery to post-market surveillance. Their focus is on assisting partners to overcome ADMET (Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, Excretion, and Toxicity) barriers in the development of drugs and medical devices, with the ultimate goal of improving human health outcomes. Pharmaron covers a wide range of research areas including in vivo, ex vivo, and in vitro support from R&D to commercial GMP. The company offers analytical testing for gene therapies, cell therapies, immunotherapies, CAR-T, and T-Cell, inclusive of in vitro cell-based potency assay development, in vivo biodistribution, toxicology, and efficacy. They also provide GMP-compliant gene/cell therapy commercial potency release testing at facilities inspected by FDA/MHRA. The company operates out of three locations in the United States: Woburn, MA; San Diego, CA; and Exton, PA. They hold certifications from the Medicines and Healthcare Products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) and the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA).

title: Rogers Imaging Corporation
description:
Rogers Imaging Corporation, based at 17 Erie Drive Natick, MA, is a leading contract research and development firm, dedicated to supporting sectors such as biotechnology, pharmacology, industrial, manufacturing, and consumer products. They partner with organizations across private, public, and industrial fields, delivering evidence-based results and transforming client requirements into tangible solutions.

description: Sanguine BioSciences, with offices in Los Angeles, Woburn, and San Diego, is a leading provider of comprehensive services for pharmaceutical and biotech companies. Their services range from autoantibody testing and clinical trial recruitment to human biological samples and real-world evidence studies. Their unique direct-to-patient model enables them to recruit and collect biospecimens from a diverse community of over 70,000 patient members. This model removes participation barriers and allows patients to contribute from their homes or local sites. Sanguine also offers an extensive inventory of readily available LeukoLots™, enabling clients to screen multiple leukopaks to ensure the right PBMC composition for their specific research needs. Additional services include patient data collection, onsite biospecimen collection programs for employees, and biorepository services from their San Diego laboratory. Sanguine is accredited by the Association for the Accreditation of Human Research Protection Programs (AAHRPP), Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA), and holds various other industry certifications.

description: SBH Sciences, based at two sites on Strathmore Road in Natick, MA, is a leading global provider of cell culture, protein production, and purification, assay development, cytotoxicity testing, cell-based assays, and cytokine profiling services. Additionally, SBH Sciences boasts 370 human cancer cell lines and offers in-vitro services for lead drug optimization. title: HitGen
description:
HitGen is a fast-growing biotech company based in Chengdu, China, with branches in Cambridge, UK and Houston, USA. Listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in April 2020, this enterprise has developed a robust drug discovery research platform that concentrates on the design, synthesis, and screening of DNA encoded chemical libraries (DELs), fragment-based drug discovery (FBDD) and structure-based drug design (SBDD) technologies. HitGen's DELs hold over 1 trillion unique, diverse, drug-like small molecules and macrocyclic compounds, drawn from hundreds of discrete chemical scaffolds. 

The company strengthened its research capabilities by acquiring Vernalis R&D Ltd, a leader in FBDD/SBDD, thereby expanding its team to over 500 scientists. The expanded scope now includes protein expression and purification, structural biology, assay development, screening, DEL synthesis, nucleic acid and small molecule chemical synthesis, and many other facets of drug discovery research. 

Furthermore, HitGen has established an integrated RNA therapeutics R&D platform that covers several crucial fields such as bioinformatics, organic chemistry, and medicinal chemistry. The platform supports both internal and external RNA therapeutics R&D projects. 

HitGen operates a flexible business model, offering a wide range of services, integrated drug discovery projects, risk-sharing projects, collaborative ventures, and program out-licensing. The company is involved in about 20 in-house drug discovery programs at various stages of research and development and collaborates with pharmaceutical, biotech, and chemical companies worldwide.

title: ICE Bioscience
description:
Established in 2010, ICE Bioscience is a leader in early drug discovery, specializing in Immuno-Oncology, Cardiovascular, and CNS diseases. The company operates through various service departments, including Biology, Electrophysiology, Biochemistry, ADME/DMPK, in vivo pharmacology, and an R&D Center. They boast over 75,000 sqft of laboratory space and a dedicated team of over 300 experts in drug discovery.

ICE Bioscience offers validated assay solutions for a wide range of druggable targets, including 100+ ion channels, 1000+ kinases/enzymes, 150+ GPCRs, 40+ nuclear receptors assays, and epigenetics and DDR targets. They also have established platforms for protein production, Biochemistry, Immunology, Oncology, Electrophysiology, in vitro Cardiac and CNS Pharmacology, off-target safety evaluation, Cardiac safety evaluation, and DMPK.

The company provides cost-effective, customized, fast-TAT, and flexible FTE working models, serving over 700 biotech and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Their preclinical biology service delivers high-quality results, helping clients manage and reduce potential risks in early drug discovery pipelines and programs.

ICE Bioscience's key features include robust target-based assays, DMPK capabilities for assessing compound stability, metabolism, and bioavailability, unique assays and platforms, translational biology expertise, and a team of seasoned scientific and regulatory professionals. With over 13 years of experience in early drug discovery, ICE Bioscience is committed to expediting and reducing the risk of clients' drug discovery pipelines, contributing to global healthcare improvement. Their headquarters is located in Building 14, VPark, No. 18 of the 13th Kechuang Street, Etown, Tongzhou, Beijing, China.

title: BioMed X
description:
BioMed X is an autonomous research institute situated in the University of Heidelberg campus, Germany, and has an extensive global network of affiliated locations. The institute is renowned for its challenge-based external innovation model and its contract research services in T cell receptor profiling for immunology discovery.

The institute's area of expertise lies in the human adaptive immune system's critical and complex component: the T lymphocyte. BioMed X has developed a unique technology platform that enables them to identify and map cognate epitopes of human T cell receptors with exceptional speed and precision. Consequently, they can profile patient-derived TCR repertoires against substantial libraries of potential target epitopes. 

Their patented platform is particularly beneficial in biomedical research and drug discovery in fields such as oncology, autoimmunity, and infectious diseases. It's also flexible enough to incorporate alternative antigen-presenting cells, scales of throughput, and multiplexing options. The institute operates on a fee-for-service basis, providing customized research projects with customers acquiring full ownership of the results without any obligation for royalty or milestone payments. 

BioMed X is located at 55 Church St New Haven, CT, 06510 United States and Im Neuenheimer Feld 515 Heidelberg, 69120 Germany, and offers services such as Antigen Specific T-cells, Epitope Mapping, High Throughput Screening, T Cell Epitope Characterization, and TCR Repertoire Sequencing.

They offer services in Assay Development, Human Biological Samples, Human Adult Stem Cells, Human Organoids, and In Vitro Assay Development.

Their portfolio includes unique models derived from human adult cells, 3D human Adipose Tissue organoids, and 2D-to-3D transition kits. These are provided in 96- and 384-well plates, which are excellent for testing and are compatible with most high-throughput systems.

They are also developing innovative Adipose Tissue and Heart 3D human models derived from human-induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs). Soon, they will launch hiPSC-derived Heart spheroids and Heart Organoids. Their mission is to turn cutting-edge science into more accurate and affordable therapies for patients worldwide through their advanced 3D solutions. For more information, feel free to contact them through their website.

title: GenScript
description:
GenScript is a globally recognized biotechnology firm specializing in gene, peptide, protein, CRISPR, and antibody services. They cater to a wide spectrum of clients, from biotech and pharma companies to academic institutions across the globe. With their unique and advanced gene synthesis technology, they have earned the status of being the largest gene synthesis provider worldwide. They also offer mutant library services based on next-generation semiconductor-based DNA synthesis, which aids in antibody and protein optimization. 

GenScript streamlines the discovery of high-quality antibodies through specialized services for monoclonal antibody development. Their catalogue of products, therapeutic and diagnostic supporting materials, and research instruments provide simple and efficient research solutions to scientists worldwide. With constant innovation, GenScript has expanded its business to include a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO), a global cell therapy group, and an industrial synthetic products platform. 

As of 2020, GenScript's diverse team of over 3,000 employees, of which approximately 30% hold Master’s and/or Ph.D. degrees, operate in subsidiaries, R&D, and manufacturing facilities across the US, Europe, and Asia. Throughout its 18-year journey, GenScript has seen exponential growth through collaborations with scientists conducting basic life science research, translational biomedical research, and early-stage pharmaceutical development. 

They are certified by the International Organization for Standards 9001 (ISO 9001), International Organization for Standards 9001:2015 (ISO 9001:2015), and the Office of Laboratory Animal Welfare (OLAW). Their widespread presence includes locations in Singapore, the United States, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and China.

title: Inotiv
description:
Inotiv is an esteemed laboratory partner offering a wide range of nonclinical and analytical services. With a comprehensive understanding of the drug discovery and development process, they exceed client expectations by providing invaluable insights and support across various therapeutic areas such as Arthritis (OA/RA), Cardio-renal, Cardiovascular, Hepatitis B, Inflammation, Immunology, and more. 

Inotiv integrates DMPK, toxicology, safety pharmacology, histopathology, image analysis, biomarker, and bioanalytical needs to guide client programs and facilitate informed decision-making. Their impeccable regulatory history, world-class team of scientists, and genuine passion for discovering life-saving therapeutics set them apart in the industry. 

Their innovative Target Sufficiency platform analyzes the protein drug targets of a variety of therapeutic approaches across numerous diseases, using high-resolution mass spectrometry technology for precise measurements. This platform provides highly specific biomarkers from discovery through clinical trials, and their bioinformatics platforms translate this data into actionable biological interpretation. 

Inotiv partners with client teams to customize analyses for the measurement of any protein form, and can also analyze archival clinical trial specimens for retrospective analysis. With multiple locations across the United States, Inotiv holds certifications from the Assessment and Accreditation of Laboratory Animal Care (AAALAC), Office of Laboratory Animal Welfare (OLAW), Public Health Service (PHS), and the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA).

description: KromaTiD, located at 1880 Industrial Circle, Longmont, CO, 80501, United States, is a leading company providing comprehensive genomic tools and services. Their expertise supports research teams in academia, large pharmaceutical, and therapeutic companies with scientific regulatory support. title: Esya Labs Inc
description:
Esya Labs Inc, located at 5145 South Cornell Avenue, Chicago, IL, is a pioneering research company specializing in biomarker discovery. Their patented chemical biology assays are designed to ratiometrically quantify ion levels within endocytic organelles, providing a unique toolkit for drug discovery. The portfolio includes single-ion sensors for pH, Chloride, Calcium, Nitric Oxide, and Membrane Potential, two-ion sensors and Enzyme Activity sensors. These assays can be applied to a range of diseases that affect lysosomes or endosomes, making them particularly useful in neurodegenerative disease research. 

Esya Labs Inc, originally a startup from the University of Chicago, primarily focuses on Alzheimer’s disease. By profiling ion signatures within key organelles, the team at Esya Labs is developing a comprehensive perspective on the disease, leading to the creation of a low-cost standalone early Alzheimer’s diagnostic, a progression monitoring system, and a personalized medicine toolkit. Esya Labs welcomes discussions on the potential applicability of their technology in your work.

title: Adeptrix Corp
description: Adeptrix Corp, located at 100 Cummings Center, Suite 451C, Beverly, MA, 01915, USA, is a renowned research reagent company. Established with a vision to bring forth an innovative analytical platform technology, Bead Assisted Mass Spectrometry (BAMS), it has carved a niche in multiplexed targeted protein analysis. BAMS is a unique platform that ingeniously merges immunoaffinity capture and mass spectrometry detection, traditionally a low throughput method due to the need for extensive upfront sample fractionation by liquid chromatography (LC-MS). However, BAMS couples bead-based immunoassays with MALDI mass spectrometry, achieving high multiplexing and high throughput capacity. It is capable of quantifying total protein abundance, protein isoforms, SNPs, and post-translationally modified (PTM) sites to perform in-depth proteomic profiling of biological samples. Adeptrix Corp offers a wide range of services, including Antibody Detection, Assay Development, Biomarker Discovery, and more.
