title: Hybrigenics Services
description:
Hybrigenics Services, with its locations in France, USA, and Japan, is a global leader in protein study technologies, offering a comprehensive range of services to its customers from over 40 countries. The company specializes in the exploration of proteins and their interactions across more than 35 organisms and various research themes. 

Their offerings are grouped into three main categories. 'Interactions Discovery' uses ULTImate Y2H™ to unearth new protein-protein interactions in diverse tissues or cell types. 'Drug Discovery Services' utilize ULTImate YChemH™ to identify the targets of small bioactive molecules, aiding in drug repositioning and toxicity prediction. 

In addition, Hybrigenics Services offers Nanobody® or Synthetic Antibodies, VHH, to select and validate high-affinity single-domain antibodies for uses ranging from high-resolution microscopy to therapeutic applications. The company's unique yeast-based screening platform enables the identification of protein partners of proteins, DNA sequences, RNA, and small therapeutic molecules. Their highly complex protein domain libraries are screened to saturation, and results are analyzed using advanced bioinformatics techniques.

Hybrigenics' work has contributed to more than 480 scientific publications to date, and their yeast two-hybrid screening technology, ULTImate Y2H, is frequently used in numerous research projects. They also offer optimization of nanobodies from the Llama using yeast display technology. Nanobody® is a trademark of Ablynx.

title: Rogers Imaging Corporation
description:
Rogers Imaging Corporation, based at 17 Erie Drive in Natick, MA, is a contract research and development firm that serves a multitude of sectors, including biotechnology, pharmacology, industrial, manufacturing, and consumer products. The company excels in facilitating organizations in various fields to achieve evidence-based outcomes, transforming customer needs into concrete solutions with substantial value. They blend global expertise with local insights to create enduring impact.

Moreover, Rogers Imaging Corporation also hosts the BioInnovations Institute, a non-profit federally funded research facility born from the BioMedical Imaging Laboratory at the Harvard School of Public Health. It supports a wide range of research activities in life sciences related to academia, biotech, and pharmaceutical industries. 

A key element of the facility is a CyTOF mass cytometer, a revolutionary tool in single-cell proteomics. It provides system-level views with single-cell resolution, from millions of data points from small blood or tissue samples. This catalyzes breakthrough discoveries and comprehensive functional profiling applications. 

The corporation collaborates regularly with top-tier clinical investigators, biotech companies, pharma companies, and basic science researchers, providing system-level biology at single-cell resolution. Their research areas include cancer research, immuno-oncology, immunology, stem cell biology, vaccine research, basic science, drug discovery, neuroscience, and translational research.

title: Advanced Cell Diagnostics, Inc. (ACD)
description:
Advanced Cell Diagnostics, Inc. (ACD), a Bio-techne brand based in Silicon Valley, is known for its proprietary RNAscope® technology. This first-of-its-kind platform supports multiplex fluorescent and chromogenic in situ hybridization, enabling detection and quantification of single RNA molecules in situ. ACD's two distinct product lines, RNAscope® and BaseScope™, include assay reagent kits and over 15,000 off-the-shelf probes. The company also offers Pharma Assay Services, facilitating rapid assay runs for unique targets. 

Since its launch in 2011, the RNAscope® technology has earned over 1500 citations, with a new publication each day for single, duplex, and multiplex RNA analysis. This technology addresses key challenges in biomarker identification and validation for companion diagnostics. It offers a novel method for localizing and measuring RNA in situ with unmatched sensitivity, specificity, and multiplexing capabilities. 

ACD's Pharma Assay Services include tissue sectioning, ISH staining, high-resolution full slide scanning, scoring, and image analysis conducted by a dedicated team of skilled specialists and board-certified pathologists. This service ensures fast, high-quality data tailored to meet study objectives and timelines. ACD has a global presence, with sites in Dublin, Oxfordshire, Zug, Wiesbaden, Noyal-Châtillon-sur-Seiche, Cambridge, and Newark.

title: Biovica
description: Biovica is a Swedish biotech company with a strong commitment to the development and commercialization of innovative blood-based biomarker assays. Established in 2009, the company's primary focus is breast cancer, a disease that causes over 685,000 deaths annually. Biovica collaborates with top cancer institutes, collaborative groups, and pharmaceutical companies to develop products aimed at improving patient outcomes and reducing healthcare costs. The company's flagship product, the DiviTum® TKa test, is capable of detecting changes in Thymidine Kinase activity levels in the blood, an essential aid in monitoring disease progression. Endorsed and funded by the European Commission Horizon 2020 phase 2 program, the DiviTum® TKa test has achieved FDA 510(k) clearance in the US and CE IVD certification in the EU. Biovica operates from two locations, in San Diego, California, and Uppsala, Sweden.

title: Doctor Evidence
description:
Doctor Evidence, located at 301 Arizona Avenue Suite 301, Santa Monica, CA, is a pioneer in advancing knowledge acceleration. This is achieved through their advanced DOC—Digital Outcome Conversion—integrated software platform utilized in Evidence-Based Medicine (EBM) decision-making. The DRE platform covers all facets of EBM work, from study identification and digitization to ontology management and final outputs such as evidence tables, statistical analysis, and quality grading.

The integrated DOC Platform consists of three modules catering to the needs of an EBM organization - DOC Library for evidence identification, DOC Data for evidence analysis, and DOC Create for document generation. 

Their range of services also includes adherence studies, clinical research, patient recruitment, real-world evidence, health economics and outcomes research (HEOR), and many more.

title: Hesperos, Inc.
description:
Hesperos, Inc., located at 12501 Research Pkwy Suite 100 in Orlando, Florida, is devoted to expediting drug discovery with its innovative Human-on-a-Chip® technology. This technology provides safety and efficacy data for new therapeutics, serving pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and food industries. It offers a unique insight into human body responses to new drugs, thereby aiding in the development of treatments for various diseases while eliminating the need for animal testing. 

Hesperos' Human-on-a-Chip is a reconfigurable, multi-organ in vitro platform that mirrors the functional aspects of human physiology. This technology evaluates both parent compounds and their metabolites, including single drug treatments and drug-drug combinations. Equipped with bioelectromechanical devices, it non-invasively monitors functional changes to organs as compounds are introduced, metabolized, and excreted. 

As a US only Small Business (SB) certified organization, Hesperos operates as a Contract Research Organization (CRO), offering compound safety and efficacy testing services using the Human-on-a-Chip platform. Their wide range of services includes Assay Development, Cell Viability, Cytotoxicity, Drug Distribution Studies, High Throughput Screening, and Solubility Studies among others.

title: Hera BioLabs
description:
Hera BioLabs is a US-based Contract Research Organization (CRO) with sites at 2277 Thunderstick Drive STE 500 and 145 Graham Avenue, both in Lexington, Kentucky. Specializing in a wide spectrum of services including Animal Model Development, Antioxidant Assays, CRISPR, Cytochrome P450s, and In Vivo Pharmacokinetics, among others, the company employs gene editing technologies to develop innovative cell lines and preclinical research models primarily for oncology and immuno-oncology.

Their platform model, the OncoRat SRG, is a uniquely enhanced immunodeficient rat model, developed on the Sprague-Dawley background with a double knockout for the Rag2 and Il2rgamma genes. The OncoRat SRG, devoid of B-cells, T-cells, and NK-cells, offers improved engraftment rates and growth profile, thereby reducing the number of animals required for xenograft efficacy study. This model can also facilitate simultaneous pharmacokinetics and toxicology studies.

Hera BioLabs is accredited by the Assessment and Accreditation of Laboratory Animal Care (AAALAC) and is recognized as a Small Business (SB) in the US. Their primary mission is to deliver the best in vivo data while using the fewest number of animals, and to provide translational enhancements without removing animals from the study.

title: Vexillum
description:
Vexillum is a renowned firm specializing in biobanking and clinical trial management. The company has established a diverse and extensive infectious disease biobank, aimed at providing a variety of human biological specimens to large medical and pharmaceutical corporations. This service significantly shortens the process of obtaining samples through clinical trials. Vexillum's collection includes various infectious disease biospecimens like SARS-CoV-2, Influenza A, and Influenza B. 

In addition to the existing collection, Vexillum offers tailored biospecimen collection to meet specific needs. This process involves multiple IRB approved collection sites prepared for immediate collection of various human biospecimens. 

One of Vexillum's major projects involved the prospective collection from 1000 donors suspected of Acute Upper Respiratory Infection, completed in just 90 days. This was achieved through a combination of all-comers collection and an enriched patient population utilizing standard of care rapid antigen testing.

With a keen focus on maintaining high standards, all samples are collected by trained clinical research staff using an IRB approved protocol, with each donor signing an IRB approved Informed Consent. Vexillum is committed to driving progress in the field of research.

title: Metabolon, Inc.
description:
Metabolon, Inc., a global leader in metabolomics, boasts more than two decades of unrivaled competency in revealing otherwise unseen biological insights. Its innovative work has significantly accelerated drug development through biomarker discovery, patient stratification, understanding mechanisms of action, and more. Metabolomics, the study of metabolites found in living organisms, provides a comprehensive snapshot of physiology, enabling a profound understanding of health, disease, and treatment response influenced by various factors including genes, the environment, epigenetics, and the microbiome.

Metabolon's unique 4Cs approach - Coverage, Competency, Comparability, and Capacity - offers the most complete biological insights into disease states and physiological reactions. Its technology provides an unmatched view of the metabolome to detect and identify metabolites with high fidelity. The company's extensive reference library includes over 5,400 known molecules, allowing comparison of thousands of molecules to reveal new insights across diverse markets.

With scalability and customization at its core, Metabolon offers metabolomics solutions from discovery through clinical trials and product life-cycle management. The company is ISO 9001:2015 certified for analytical and diagnostic testing of biological specimens, CLIA certified, and CAP accredited for diagnostic testing on human specimens. Established in 2000, Metabolon is headquartered in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina.

title: Xylyx Bio, Inc.
description:
Located at 760 Parkside Avenue Suite #321 in Brooklyn, NY, Xylyx Bio, Inc. is a small business with a mission to enhance predictiveness and confidence in drug discovery for serious diseases such as cancer and fibrosis. Leveraging their proprietary IN MATRICO™ platform, Xylyx Bio develops physiologically-relevant models that incorporate human tissue and disease-specific extracellular matrix substrates. These substrates, combined with clinically relevant data packages, allow drug candidates to be tested in high-fidelity disease models that accurately reflect human disease biology. 

Xylyx Bio's innovative offerings include custom fibrotic human lung and liver ECM substrates and IN MATRICO™ compound testing services. These tools significantly improve in-vitro disease modeling and drug development by creating a disease-relevant environment that emulates human fibrosis, providing valuable insights into fibrotic mechanisms. 

The company also offers NativeCoat™ ECM Surface Coating and TissueSpec® ECM Hydrogels and Scaffolds. NativeCoat™ ECM Coatings provide cells with key physiological factors that regulate growth and function. TissueSpec® Hydrogels enhance cell attachment, interaction, and expansion, while TissueSpec® ECM Scaffolds retain the natural 3D biomechanics and structural topography of native tissues, creating an optimal environment for studying the effects of native tissue mechanics on cell differentiation or migration.

title: Advanced Cellular Dynamics, Inc.
description:
Advanced Cellular Dynamics, Inc., based in Seattle, Washington, is at the forefront of cell-based assay panel technologies, providing critical services to the life science community. The company believes in the importance of cells as the optimal context for discovering biologically and chemically relevant entities. ACD's mission is to facilitate drug discovery by developing cell-based assay panels that represent a wide range of pharmaceutically relevant gene families, beginning with kinases. 

Their state-of-the-art labs are physically isolated, each one designed for a specific function, ensuring an efficient workflow and preventing potential contamination. The molecular biology facility handles all aspects of gene isolation, modification, and expression in both prokaryotic and eukaryotic systems. The tissue culture suite then takes over for the production of the corresponding cell-based assay systems. Finally, these assays are validated in the screening facilities for performance and long-term stability before they are incorporated into ACD's growing panel of assays. 

ACD's unique approach enables an unprecedented examination of a compound's functional specificity, leading to the development of selective and well-characterized drugs, accelerating drug discovery efforts, and helping to avoid unforeseen side effects.

title: AIQ Global, Inc.
description:
AIQ Global, Inc. is a commercial-stage imaging biomarker firm based in Madison, Wisconsin, with an additional office in Perth, Australia. Their specialized software technologies interpret medical scans from all imaging modalities and radiotracers, enhancing the efficiency of clinical decision-making and patient selection for clinical trials. The company is known for its unique ability to quantify lesion-specific treatment responses, leading to improved predictions of clinical outcomes and organ-specific toxicity risk. 

AIQ Global has pioneered a patient-level metric system, AIQ Score, which facilitates early determination of patient responses to therapy. The company was established in 2015, with its founding members boasting decades of combined expertise in drug development, clinical trials, and translational imaging research from the University of Wisconsin Carbone Cancer Center. AIQ Global's innovations are protected by patents issued in 2015 and 2017 and hold an exclusive license agreement with the Wisconsin Alumni Research Foundation. 

The company's suite of services includes Biomarker Clinical Validation, Discovery, Services, Consulting, Pharmacodynamic Biomarkers Discovery, Positron Emission Tomography (PET) Imaging, Predictive Biomarkers Discovery, and SPECT-CT and PET-CT Imaging. AIQ Global is certified under the Quality Systems Medical Devices (EN 46001) and has passed ISO – 13485:2016 audits.
